## Selected Projects

### Transit-Accessible Provider Routing (The WHO Project)

Architecting a dbt and BigQuery ELT pipeline to integrate NYS Medicaid/Medicare Provider data with MTA Static GTFS transit data. Utilizing Slowly Changing Dimensions to track provider mobility and bridge the geospatial "referral gap" for patients over systemic barriers.

### Patient Experience Survey Clustering

Designing a KMeans-based clustering workflow for open-ended patient-experience survey comments, with the goal of converting unstructured feedback into interpretable service themes and actionable operational insight.

### Geospatial Advocacy & Predictive Modeling

Built a contextual statistical model using Poisson regression to evaluate socioeconomic resource drivers in New York City, unmasking institutional anomalies that distort public healthcare allocation.  

### Healthcare Systems Modeling Research

Conducted a comprehensive 15-year literature review analyzing quantitative modeling methodologies within healthcare ecosystems. Evaluated historical operational bottlenecks, current systemic solutions, and unaddressed gaps in care delivery optimization.

### Statistical Analysis of Clinical Metrics

Utilized R to execute simple linear regression modeling, evaluating the effects of specific independent variables on patient glucose levels to demonstrate foundational competency in programmatic data evaluation.
